question: Which half-hour on 29 July 2026 (Brisbane time) had Queensland's highest operational demand, and how many MW was it?

shown_answer.headline: Queensland’s maximum operational demand was 7,548 MW in the half-hour ending 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST.
summary: QLD1 operational demand was highest at 7548 MW in the half-hour ending 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z = 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST, over all of 2026-07-29 (AEST).
The maximum uses the latest available updated actual operational-demand data and is a half-hour average, not dispatch TOTALDEMAND.
For price context, the highest regional reference price was 121.12 $/MWh at the interval ending 2026-07-29 17:45 AEST.
There were 0 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300 $/MWh.
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price maximum, ending 2026-07-29 18:00 AEST, was 7,448 MW.
